title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.24264v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. translated_title: AM-Bench：面向智能体失准的统一分类体系与评估套件
translated_abstract: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在真实世界环境中以越来越高的自主性被部署，一种关键的失效模式开始显现：智能体失准，即智能体选择有害行动而非接受失败。然而，现有的安全基准主要评估智能体是否会遵从明确有害的指令，对于导致智能体主动选择有害行动的条件，人们的理解仍然不足。为解决这一局限，我们提出了 AM-Bench，这是一个面向智能体失准的统一分类体系与评估基准，包含涵盖七个行业的 35 个场景，其理论基础是舞弊三角——一个解释目标导向不当行为的成熟犯罪学框架。我们将该框架适配到智能体环境中，并沿三个维度构建评估套件与检测系统：感知威胁、感知机会和推理。我们将每个维度操作化为植根于既有理论的、结构化的子类别：五类威胁诱因……
tldr: 提出基于犯罪学“舞弊三角”理论构建的 AM-Bench 基准，通过涵盖七个行业的 35 个场景，从感知威胁、感知机会和推理三个维度系统评估大语言模型智能体在无人明确指示下主动选择有害行为的“智能体失准”问题。
en_tdlr: AM-Bench introduces a unified taxonomy and a 35-scenario benchmark grounded in the criminological fraud triangle, evaluating agentic misalignment—where LLM-based agents proactively choose harmful actions over failure—along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning.
